payload.text: Analyze core/src/stall_detector.cpp and test suite core/tests/test_stall.cpp. Verify the cycle detection logic for diff loops, tool failures, and read thrashing. Investigate whether the sliding window properly evicts stale hashes, and implement strict circular reference detection for multi-agent tool handoffs. Validate your changes against ctest without breaking any binary wire formats in core/include/chrono/event.h.
